component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.ui.config
component.documentation:
The UI configuration of Nuxeo Agentic UI, contributed by Marketplace packages.
A customer ships their own package: package.xml declares a dependency on nuxeo-agentic-ui, which orders installation, and its component requires org.nuxeo.agentic.ui.config.defaults, which orders the contributions. The servlet serves the result, in contribution order, at /nuxeo/agentic-ui-config/ (bootstrap.json, manifest.json, layouts.json, layouts/, assets/), without authentication — nothing sensitive may be contributed. The browser merges the fragments in order, so a later package wins key by key.
